title: From the first Tudor king to Lamine Yamal
description:
Four centuries of English monarchs and three real photos link King Henry VII to Lamine Yamal.

Henry VII → Elizabeth II → Donald Trump → Pedro Sánchez → Lamine Yamal

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
